helper_scope: Only publicly committed tree.cu and window_schedule_shared.cuh snippets, extracted with git show HEAD and checked against unauthenticated public raw URLs.
claims_independently_checked: Both variants load the same eight first-state words for a given lane.
Eight-rotation SHA round sequences and feed-forward match.
Four constant blocks are processed in order 0,1,2,3.
S2Round uses uint32 arithmetic and only its passed working state plus t1/t2 temporaries.
correction: The helper unnecessarily required firstA and firstB to be nonaliasing. These inputs are read-only; they may alias for an odd final epoch. The two output state arrays are distinct local arrays.
limits: This verifies a local SHA equivalence argument, not whole-grinder correctness or a GPU performance gain. A GPU miter and independent CPU/OpenSSL oracle are prepared.
